plan: Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above my value to maximize the chance of winning while ensuring a profit. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, a bid slightly above my value can deter others from overbidding without sacrificing profit. Assuming rationality, others will bid close to their values. I will bid $24.1 to have a chance of winning while minimizing overpayment.

Given my value is $9, I need to ensure my bid is below this to avoid a loss. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To win, I must outbid the third-highest bid but not exceed my value. Thus, I should bid slightly below my value, anticipating others may bid similarly. I will bid $8.9, maximizing my chance of winning while ensuring a potential profit.

Given my value of $13, I aim to bid slightly above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit. Since values range from $0 to $49, the average bid is around $24.5. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To win, I should bid slightly above the lower third of the range, aiming for a bid of $5. This ensures I pay less than my value if I win, maximizing my profit.
